term: dar por la vena del gusto

1.consolidated_definition: Plantearle a uno el tema favorito de este. También cogerle a uno la vena del gusto. Equivale a darle a uno por la cuerda.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To bring up one's favorite topic with someone, to get on their good side by appealing to their tastes or interests. This is equivalent to stringing them along.
